subject: Procurement follow-up: budget owners & commercial path — Acme Corp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@acme-corp.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement follow-up: budget owners & commercial path — Acme Corp

Thanks again for taking the call this morning — really appreciate the time. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can move the commercial process along: 

1) Recap of next steps from discovery
- Your team is evaluating Redwood for model inference for both customer-facing features and internal ML workloads.
- Target start: Q2 pilot (proof-of-concept) with potential production ramp in Q3.
- Primary technical constraint: data residency in us-west + preference for reserved capacity for predictable throughput.

2) Procurement / commercial path
- Can you confirm whether Acme prefers issuing a PO (Net 30/60) or paying by corporate card for initial purchases?
- Are you interested in marketplace procurement (AWS Marketplace / Azure Marketplace) or do you need a standard vendor P.O. and invoice?
- Does procurement need a SOW or is a short vendor agreement + order form sufficient?

3) Budget owner & approvals
- Who is the economic buyer for this initiative (title/name)?
- Do you have a finance sponsor who will own the PO and sign-off?
- Any other signatory/approvals required (legal, procurement, IT security)?

Attached is a short proposal and a draft SOW that map to the pricing discussed on the call (see attachments). If it helps, we can also surface a marketplace pricing option for a cleaner procurement path.

Attachments: Redwood-Proposal-Acme-20260330.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
             Redwood-SOW-Acme-20260330.docx (DOCX, 3 pages)

Proposed next steps:
- Jamie/Sam: confirm procurement path (PO vs card) and name of budget owner/finance sponsor by EOD Wed 3/31
- Marissa/Vivek: prepare marketplace pricing option and shortened order form if preferred

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call with procurement or legal to walk through the SOW if useful.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0148

From: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme-corp.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Mar 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement follow-up: budget owners & commercial path — Acme Corp

Thanks Marissa — good summary. A few answers from procurement side: 

- For the pilot, procurement would prefer a PO (Net 30). Our preferred path is a vendor PO + invoice. For longer commitments we'll consider marketplace if pricing and contract terms align.
- We will need a short SOW that calls out deliverables for the pilot; legal will want to review any vendor agreement.
- Budget owner for this initiative is Lina Gomez, VP Product (lina.gomez@acme-corp.com).
- Finance sponsor who will approve the PO is Rajesh Nair, Director of Finance (rajesh.nair@acme-corp.com).
- Signatory: Procurement is the initial approver; final signature authority for >$100k is our CFO (cfo@acme-corp.com).

I'll loop procurement on the SOW review — copying procurement mailbox. Sam and I can also join a 30m call with legal if that speeds things up.

Jamie
Director, Product Operations
Acme Corp
jamie.torres@acme-corp.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@acme-corp.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme-corp.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 01 Apr 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement follow-up: budget owners & commercial path — Acme Corp

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Jamie — that's very helpful. We've updated the SOW to call out the pilot deliverables and included a short order form (see attached).

A couple items from our side: 
- We'll prepare a PO-friendly invoice and order form (Net 30) and can also provide an AWS Marketplace SKU and consolidated invoice if you want to evaluate that route in parallel.
- Vivek, could you prepare a condensed marketplace pricing option that matches the estimated pilot usage (we'll attach both for Acme so they can choose)?

Jamie/Sam — attached files: Redwood-Proposal-Acme-20260330.pdf, Redwood-SOW-Acme-20260330.docx. If you can confirm Lina and Rajesh as the budget owner and finance sponsor, we'll route the package to legal and procurement with a suggested signatory path (procurement -> finance -> CFO if >$100k).

If a short call helps, I'm free Thurs 4/2 9-11am PT to run through the SOW with legal/procurement.

Attachments: Redwood-Proposal-Acme-20260330.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
             Redwood-SOW-Acme-20260330.docx (DOCX, 3 pages)

Best,

Marissa Cole

marissa.cole@redwood.inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Acme procurement path & approvals (quick ask)

Vivek / Aditya — quick internal note following Acme thread (summary + ask):

Summary: Acme prefers PO (Net 30) for the pilot. Budget owner = Lina Gomez (VP Product), finance sponsor = Rajesh Nair (Director Finance), final signatory = CFO if total > $100k. They may evaluate marketplace but procurement prefers PO route for now.

Ask: 
- Vivek: can you draft a marketplace pricing option that matches the attached proposal (pilot estimate: 100k tokens/month, reserved baseline to start)? I'd like both a PO-friendly invoice and marketplace SKU to include in the package.
- Aditya: can you confirm whether we can offer a shortened order form + standard SOW language for Acme (legal prefers minimal redlines for pilot)? If there are recommended concession/discounts for pilot customers in this tier, please flag.

Deliverable timeline: aiming to send the full procurement package to Acme by EOD Fri 4/2. If either of you want to hop on a quick 15-min sync today, I can carve time at 2:30pm PT.

Thanks —
Marissa
